scope_note: Passive, non-intrusive inspection of HTTP response headers, cookies and TLS certificates. No exploitation, fuzzing, credential testing, port scanning or denial-of-service behaviour. Point it only at systems you own or have written permission to test.

tls.subject: CN=secscan-lab,O=Ethical Hacking Lab
tls.verify_error: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy header missing
findings.detail: Without CSP the browser has no policy restricting script sources, so any injected markup executes as the page origin.
findings.remediation: Send a CSP that whitelists script sources, for example: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'.

findings.title: Cookie "session_id" is readable from JavaScript (no HttpOnly)
findings.detail: Without HttpOnly any cross-site scripting bug can exfiltrate or replace this cookie through document.cookie.
findings.remediation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to the cookie.

findings.title: Cookie "remember_me" is readable from JavaScript (no HttpOnly)
findings.detail: Without HttpOnly any cross-site scripting bug can exfiltrate or replace this cookie through document.cookie.
findings.remediation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to the cookie.

findings.title: Cookie "csrf_token" is readable from JavaScript (no HttpOnly)
findings.detail: Without HttpOnly any cross-site scripting bug can exfiltrate or replace this cookie through document.cookie.
findings.remediation: Add the HttpOnly attribute to the cookie.

findings.title: Cookie "csrf_token" uses SameSite=None without Secure
findings.detail: SameSite=None requires Secure; browsers reject the combination, and until they do the cookie is sent cross-site over plaintext.
findings.remediation: Add Secure, or switch to SameSite=Lax/Strict.

findings.title: Cookie "session_id" is missing the Secure flag
findings.detail: The cookie was set on an encrypted page but lacks Secure, so browsers will also send it over plaintext http://, where it can be captured.
findings.remediation: Add the Secure attribute and serve the application over HTTPS only.

findings.title: Cookie "remember_me" is missing the Secure flag
findings.detail: The cookie was set on an encrypted page but lacks Secure, so browsers will also send it over plaintext http://, where it can be captured.
findings.remediation: Add the Secure attribute and serve the application over HTTPS only.

findings.title: Cookie "csrf_token" is missing the Secure flag
findings.detail: The cookie was set on an encrypted page but lacks Secure, so browsers will also send it over plaintext http://, where it can be captured.
findings.remediation: Add the Secure attribute and serve the application over HTTPS only.

findings.title: Strict-Transport-Security header missing
findings.detail: HSTS tells browsers to always use HTTPS, which blocks SSL-stripping and http-to-https downgrade attacks.
findings.remediation: Send: Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains

findings.title: Clickjacking protection missing (X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors)
findings.detail: The page can be embedded by another origin, which is the basis of clickjacking attacks.
findings.remediation: Send: X-Frame-Options: DENY (or SAMEORIGIN); prefer CSP frame-ancestors 'none'.

findings.title: Cookie "session_id" has no SameSite attribute
findings.detail: Browsers then apply their own default, which historically meant the cookie rode along on cross-site requests, enabling CSRF.
findings.remediation: Set SameSite=Lax for session cookies; use SameSite=None only when cross-site posting is genuinely required.

findings.title: Cookie "remember_me" has no SameSite attribute
findings.detail: Browsers then apply their own default, which historically meant the cookie rode along on cross-site requests, enabling CSRF.
findings.remediation: Set SameSite=Lax for session cookies; use SameSite=None only when cross-site posting is genuinely required.

findings.title: Self-signed certificate (no trusted issuer)
findings.detail: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
findings.remediation: Install a certificate from a public CA, or distribute your internal CA root to clients. Self-signed material is acceptable only inside an isolated lab.

findings.title: Certificate expires in 2 day(s)
findings.detail: Certificates within a month of expiry commonly lapse silently and cause outages and warning pages.
findings.remediation: Renew now and automate renewal (for example ACME/certbot with a timer).

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff missing
findings.detail: Browsers may MIME-sniff a response and execute it as a content type other than the one declared.
findings.remediation: Send: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff on every response.

findings.title: Authentication-related path /login is served without Cache-Control: no-store
findings.detail: Shared caches and browser history may retain a response that carries credentials, tokens or personal data.
findings.remediation: Send: Cache-Control: no-store on login, token, session and account responses.

findings.title: Cookie "session_id" is scoped to the whole domain "localhost"
findings.detail: Every current and future subdomain receives this cookie, so a weak subdomain can read or set session material for the main application.
findings.remediation: Omit Domain, or pin it to the exact host that needs the cookie.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy header missing
findings.detail: Outbound requests can leak full URLs - which often carry tokens or identifiers - to third-party origins in the Referer header.
findings.remediation: Send: Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin (or no-referrer for sensitive pages).

findings.title: X-Powered-By exposes the technology stack
findings.detail: Framework and runtime versions advertised in headers narrow down which known issues apply to this host.
findings.remediation: Disable the banner: Express app.disable('x-powered-by'); PHP expose_php = Off.

findings.title: Cookie "remember_me" appears to carry a JWT
findings.detail: Tokens in cookies inherit every header risk above; also confirm the signature algorithm, expiry, and that refresh tokens are not stored client-side.
findings.remediation: Keep HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite, use short access-token lifetimes, and store long-lived tokens server-side.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy header missing
findings.detail: Browser features such as camera, microphone and geolocation stay available to the document and its embeds.
findings.remediation: Send: Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=() to disable features the app does not use.

findings.title: Server header discloses a software version
findings.detail: A versioned product banner can be matched directly against public vulnerability and exploit data.
findings.remediation: Remove the version detail, leaving at most a generic product name. Nginx: server_tokens off; Apache: ServerTokens Prod.
